ja.title: モデルが勝てないときに追加する観測
ja.summary: 摂動予測とVirtual Cellの研究を読み、情報の不足、モデルの未活用、評価の低感度を切り分ける。観測時点と信号の希釈の数式例から、同じ適合度でも予測の安定性が異なる理由を考える。

en.title: When a model fails to beat the baseline, what should we measure next?
en.summary: A Japanese essay on separating limitations of data, models and evaluation in perturbation prediction. Original analytical examples illustrate sampling-time identifiability and signal dilution; recent studies inform a practical measurement audit. This is not a reanalysis of empirical cell data.
en.seo_title: When perturbation data cannot distinguish models
en.seo_description: Mathematical examples and perturbation studies separate data informativeness, identifiability and evaluation sensitivity from model complexity.
